name: Exp_XRSI_Histogram_Vol_Direct
summary: This EA trades based on Extended RSI histogram signals with volume confirmation. It enters positions directly when the XRSI histogram indicates momentum shifts confirmed by volume activity, and exits on signal reversal or stop conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于扩展RSI直方图信号并结合成交量确认进行交易。当XRSI直方图显示动量转变且成交量确认时，直接开仓进场，在信号反转或止损条件触发时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于XRSI扩展RSI直方图的动量方向变化来捕捉趋势启动点。入场条件为：XRSI直方图从负转正时做多，从正转负时做空，同时要求成交量放大以确认动量有效性。出场条件包括：XRSI直方图信号反转时平仓、固定止损止损触发、或达到固定止盈目标。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有动态加仓或减仓机制。资金管理方面仅依赖固定止损和止盈参数控制单笔风险，缺乏基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整。策略属于典型的动量跟随型系统，依赖RSI动量变化和成交量确认来过滤假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy captures trend initiation points based on XRSI (Extended RSI) histogram momentum direction changes. Entry conditions: go long when XRSI histogram crosses from negative to positive, go short when it crosses from positive to negative, both requiring volume expansion confirmation to validate momentum. Exit conditions include: XRSI histogram signal reversal closing the position, fixed stop-loss being triggered, or reaching a fixed take-profit target. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic scaling in or out mechanisms. Money management relies solely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk, lacking dynamic position sizing based on account equity or volatility. The strategy is a typical momentum-following system that depends on RSI momentum shifts and volume confirmation to filter false signals.
pros: 多维度信号确认：结合RSI动量和成交量过滤假信号，减少错误入场
信号直观：直方图形式展示RSI动量方向，便于理解和调参
固定风险参数：止损止盈明确，单笔风险可控
Direct模式入场迅速：信号确认后立即市价入场，不会错过最佳入场时机
pros_en: Multi-dimensional signal confirmation: combining RSI momentum with volume filters reduces false entries
Intuitive signal presentation: histogram format displays RSI momentum direction clearly, easing understanding and parameter tuning
Defined risk parameters: fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide controllable per-trade risk
Direct mode for swift entry: market order execution upon signal confirmation avoids missing optimal entry timing
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理：固定手数无法根据账户规模和波动率自适应调整
无新K线检查机制：可能在同一根K线上重复开仓，增加过度交易风险
成交量确认在高流动性市场有效性降低：在24小时外汇市场中成交量数据不如期货市场可靠
缺少加仓和追踪止损机制：盈利时无法锁定浮动利润，限制了策略的盈利潜力
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing: fixed lots cannot adapt to account size and market volatility changes
No new bar check mechanism: may repeatedly open positions on the same bar, increasing overtrading risk
Volume confirmation less effective in high-liquidity markets: forex volume data is less reliable than futures market tick volume
Missing trailing stop and scale-in mechanisms: unable to lock in floating profits, limiting the strategy's profit potential
improvements: 增加动态仓位计算：基于ATR波动率和账户余额百分比计算最优手数
添加新K线检查：确保每根K线只处理一次信号，避免重复开仓
引入追踪止损：盈利达到阈值后启动追踪止损锁定利润
增加多时间周期过滤：更高时间周期趋势方向确认以提高胜率
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing: calculate optimal lot size based on ATR volatility and account equity percentage
Implement new bar check: ensure each bar is processed only once to prevent duplicate entries
Introduce trailing stop: activate trailing stop after profit threshold to lock in gains
Add multi-timeframe filter: confirm trade direction with higher timeframe trend to improve win rate

risk_points: 无新K线检查可能导致同一K线多次开仓，增加过度交易和滑点风险
固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动期止损过宽而高波动期止损过窄
成交量确认在外汇市场可靠性有限，可能导致假信号漏过滤
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same bar, increasing overtrading and slippage risk
Fixed stop-loss does not account for volatility changes: too wide in low volatility and too narrow in high volatility periods
Volume confirmation has limited reliability in forex markets, potentially allowing false signals to pass the filter

summary_en: This EA trades based on Extended RSI histogram signals with volume confirmation. It enters positions directly when the XRSI histogram indicates momentum shifts confirmed by volume activity, and exits on signal reversal or stop conditions.
